paper_title: VideoLLaMB Long-context Video Understanding with Recurrent Memory   Bridges
caption: Length extrapolation results on EgoSchema dataset.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the accuracy performance of different video understanding models as a function of the number of frames, based on length extrapolation results on the EgoSchema dataset. The x-axis, labeled "Number of Frames," ranges from 0 to 65 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 10. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (%)", ranges from 40 to 54 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 2. Four distinct lines represent different models: a blue line with circular markers for "Ours (Dynamic Seg)", a green line with circular markers for "Ours (Static 4-Seg)", an orange line with square markers for "PLLaVA (DP 8)", and a red line with square markers for "PLLaVA (DP 16)". The blue line starts at approximately 53% accuracy at 10 frames and remains nearly flat, ending at about 53.5% at 65 frames. The green line begins at around 52% at 10 frames and also remains relatively flat, ending at approximately 53.2% at 65 frames. The orange line starts at about 45% at 10 frames and shows a steady decline to approximately 40% at 65 frames. The red line begins at approximately 45.5% at 10 frames and also declines steadily to about 42% at 65 frames. All lines are solid, and the plot includes a grid for easier reading of values.
